xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4754: Operator decision dialog renders as one run-on paragraph: render markdown, separate context, tighten pan ask guidance

plan.title: Operator decision dialog renders as one run-on paragraph: render markdown, separate context, tighten pan ask guidance
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem:
Operator decisions from `pan ask` (and transcript AskUserQuestion prompts) render in the dashboard dialog as one run-on paragraph. `operatorDecisionAsPendingQuestion` (src/lib/cloister/operator-decision.ts) concatenates question and context into `question`, and AskUserQuestionDialog.tsx renders it in a plain

that collapses newlines and ignores markdown. roles/work.md tells agents to pack every fact into the quoted question argument, and option labels end up as full sentences.
narratives.Proposal: Carry `context` as its own optional field on the pending question (operator-decision.ts -> agent-enrichment.ts toPendingAskUserQuestion -> contracts schemas -> frontend types). Render the question and the context with the shared ChatMarkdown component in the decision dialog, context in a muted bordered block under the question. Show context as plain pre-line text on the other two answer surfaces (SimpleQuestionCard, MobileNeedsYou); summary surfaces keep showing the question only. Rewrite the `pan ask` section of roles/work.md (short question, markdown bullet context with real newlines, short option labels, worked example) with a Prompt-Change trailer. Prove the rendering with a committed Playwright spec on the isolated-dashboard fixture (light + dark screenshots) and document the contract in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md. Operator-approved design-review scope (FR-8..FR-14): make the dialog an accessible modal with focus trap, add Esc / Cmd+Enter / number-key shortcuts that never leak to global shortcuts, radio/checkbox option semantics with multiSelect, option-plus-note answers, consequences lifted next to options from `- **<label>:**` context lines, decision-first layout with a waiting age, and the amber needs-you tone with a single-Send footer. These six items all edit AskUserQuestionDialog.tsx and run in sequence.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to `pan ask` CLI flags, help text or the pipeline journal entry format (NFR-1).
- No option-description syntax for `--option`; consequences go in the context.
- No new dependencies; reuse ChatMarkdown (NFR-2). Do not copy UpdateDialog's bare ReactMarkdown + prose-invert.
- Do not modify ChatMarkdown.tsx itself.
- Summary surfaces (NeedsYouStrip, DecisionsPanel row, SimpleHomePage sentence, SessionFeedSidebar, browser/push notification previews, useIssueView prompt, awaitingInput prompt) do not gain the context; they show the question only.
- No change to conversation-row pending-question types (ConversationList.tsx); conversations never carry operator decisions.
- No markdown rendering in SimpleQuestionCard or MobileNeedsYou (plain pre-line text only).
- No change to docs/GOD-VIEW.md, configuration/push-notifications.mdx or docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md; they mention `pan ask` but not its text format.
- No focus-trap or hotkey library (NFR-2).
- No change to the answer wire contract: answers stay string[] one per question; a note is appended to the last answer as '\n\nNote: <note>'.
- No consequence lifting on SimpleQuestionCard or MobileNeedsYou.

autoDecisions.summary: Answer surfaces (decision dialog, SimpleQuestionCard, MobileNeedsYou) show the context; summary surfaces show the question only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires consumers to keep the context where they show it today. The three answer surfaces show full text and let the operator decide, so they keep it. Summary surfaces clamp or truncate (NeedsYouStrip line-clamp-2, push preview 140 chars), so the context rarely showed there. This corrects the earlier PRD FR-4, which wrongly filed SimpleQuestionCard and MobileNeedsYou as compact summaries.

autoDecisions.summary: SimpleQuestionCard and MobileNeedsYou render the context as plain text with whitespace-pre-line, not ChatMarkdown.
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest change that keeps line breaks readable; avoids adding providers to those components' tests. The dialog is the primary answer surface and gets full markdown.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshot verification is a committed Playwright spec (tests/pan-4754-decision-dialog.spec.ts) on the isolated-dashboard fixture with a mocked pending-input row.
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the existing pan-2355-mobile.spec.ts recipe, is repeatable, and satisfies Playwright isolation (own temp OVERDECK_HOME, own port, own browser context).

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse ChatMarkdown in the dialog rather than bare react-markdown as the issue suggested.
autoDecisions.rationale: ChatMarkdown wraps react-markdown + remark-gfm with dashboard theming and is already used by the sibling PlanApprovalDialog; UpdateDialog's bare ReactMarkdown uses prose-invert and ignores the light theme. Satisfies the issue's intent (GFM rendering) with no new dependencies.

autoDecisions.summary: Folded the operator-approved design-review addendum (FR-8..FR-14, work items 7-12) into the PRD and plan; serialized all dialog items because they edit the same file.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator instruction 2026-11-01. Items 2 and 7-12 all mutate AskUserQuestionDialog.tsx and its test file, so the shared-mutation rule requires edges.
